description: Search Google News (any language and country) and return articles with the publisher's real article URL, publisher, date and related coverage. Supports Google operators ("exact phrase", -exclude, OR, intitle:) and site filters. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/google-news on your Apify account (about $0.002 per article; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

country.description: Two-letter edition country, e.g. US, GB, DE.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

language.description: Language code, e.g. en, de, fr.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 20, max 200). Cost scales with this.

sites.description: Limit to these publisher domains, e.g. ["reuters.com"].

name: search_google_news

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search Google News
